_comment: Reviewed exceptions to the dependency licence policy in docs/05-licensing-and-compliance.md section 1.
An entry here means a human read the licence text and accepted the risk in writing. It is not a way to
silence the gate: scripts/check-licences.mjs rejects an entry that is missing a reason, an approver or an
approval date, and rejects a reason short enough to be a placeholder.
package     exact npm package name, e.g. "some-package" or "@scope/some-package"
version     optional exact version; omit to allow every version of the package
licence     the declared licence being excepted, as it appears in the package's package.json
reason      why this dependency is acceptable despite the policy, in enough detail that someone
who was not in the conversation can re-evaluate it
approver    who accepted the risk — a person, never a team
approved_on absolute YYYY-MM-DD date of the approval
expires_on  optional absolute YYYY-MM-DD date by which the exception is re-reviewed or removed
AGPL, SSPL and BSL/BUSL dependencies are not expected to appear here at all. If one does, it is a
product-level decision with legal involvement and it needs an ADR, not an allowlist row (ADR-001).
Zero entries as of 2026-09-15, and the shorter this file stays the better.
